visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male creator standing in front of a red wall with various app icons, wearing a beige jacket and black shirt. The background is brightly lit with a studio-like feel. (2) A transition shows a close-up of a promotional poster for 'Mercari Secret Base' with a red shipping box graphic. (3) The creator opens a dark door and enters a dimly lit red room, looking surprised. (4) The scene shifts to a bright exhibit space filled with red display cases and wall shelves containing numerous collectible trading cards. (5) Close-up shots focus on rare graded cards like Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Pokémon cards behind glass, with the creator gesturing toward them. (6) The creator stands before a large infographic board explaining event missions, using his hands to point at different steps. (7) He is seen interacting with a hidden compartment to find a stamp, then uses a photo booth while holding a red card. (8) The creator shows a large red shopping bag and unboxes a 'blind box' on camera, displaying stickers and accessories. (9) The creator walks out through a door, and the video concludes with a full-screen promotional graphic for the 11.11 shopping festival featuring discounts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop BGM starts immediately. A male speaker introduces the topic with high energy and clarity. (2) A sharp mechanical 'click' and friction sound occur as the creator opens the entrance door. (3) The BGM continues as the speaker describes the cards, with his voice remaining loud and expressive. (4) A digital 'beep' SFX triggers as the creator touches an interactive element. (5) A series of camera shutter SFX and a short burst of a canned laughter track play during the photo booth segment. (6) Audible rustling of plastic bags and box lids occurs during the unboxing of the gift. (7) The speaker ends with a call to action over an energetic musical swell.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> On-site Exploration -> Task Completion -> Reward Reveal -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'Mercari Secret Base' pop-up event and the Mercari app's 11.11 shopping festival. By showing the rare collectibles on display and the fun interactive rewards available, it encourages users to visit the physical site and engage with the platform's promotional activities.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is physically at a branded event venue, explains app-related missions, and explicitly mentions the platform's shopping festival deals.
